description: This Java source file defines an abstract controller class for a web application, providing common utility methods for session management, exception handling, and pagination data creation.

classes.name: AbstractController
classes.description: An abstract base controller class providing common web controller utilities such as session attribute management, exception handling, and pagination support.

methods.name: getSessionAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a session attribute value based on the provided key from the HTTP request.

methods.name: setSessionAttribute
methods.description: Sets a session attribute value based on the provided key in the HTTP request.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes a session attribute based on the provided key from the HTTP request.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the Language object from the request attributes.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles exceptions thrown during request processing, returning appropriate error views.

methods.name: createPaginaionData
methods.description: Creates a PaginationData object for a specified page number and size.

methods.name: calculatePaginaionData
methods.description: Calculates and sets the total result count into the PaginationData object.
